## normalize() function

Returns a vector with the same direction as the input `v`<!-- -->, but with a Euclidean norm of 1

**Signature:**

```typescript
export declare function normalize<S>(v: Vector<S>): Vector<S> | undefined;
```

## Example


```
const v = vec(3, 4);
```
